div.span:
Flight Disruption Detected
(Authoritative Carrier Webhook / Radar Ingress)

WhatsApp Interactive Notification
[ RESCUE MY TRIP ] | [ ABANDON RESCUE ]

PASSENGER_DECLINED
Close Rescue Case
Preserve Original Ticket (No Auto-Refund)
Alert Agency Operations Desk

Validate Passenger Ownership
Fetch Complete PNR & All Itinerary Segments
Analyze Downstream Connection & Hotel Risks

Search Candidate Alternatives
Calculate MCT Buffer & Connection Feasibility
Deterministic Multi-Factor Option Ranking

NO_OPTIONS_AVAILABLE → ESCALATED
Hand over to Human Travel Desk

Send Ranked Options on WhatsApp
• Option 1 (Recommended)
• Option 2
• Option 3

Passenger Selects Flight Option
(e.g., SELECT_OPTION_O1 or O2)

REVALIDATING_OPTION
Revalidate Live Carrier Seat Availability & Fare Rules
Recalculate Downstream Feasibility

OPTION_EXPIRED → REFRESHING_ALTERNATIVES
Closed-Loop Inventory Refresh & Return to Options

FARE_CHANGED → Display Updated Cost
Require Fresh Passenger Consent & New OTP

Present Final Itinerary Preview & Exact Cost
Generate Single-Use Confirmation OTP
(Bound to Case + Phone + Option + Fare + Currency)

OTP_FAILED → AWAITING_PASSENGER_OTP
Decrement Attempt Counter & Prompt Retry

OTP_EXPIRED → AWAITING_PASSENGER_OTP
Regenerate Fresh Challenge & Prompt Retry

LOCKED_OUT → ESCALATED
30-Minute Security Lockout
Alert Operations Desk

PATH A: NO PAYMENT REQUIRED
• Skip VCC Issuance Entirely
• Skip Payment Gateway Processing
• REBOOKING Directly Dispatched

PATH B: PAYMENT REQUIRED
VERIFYING_AGENCY_APPROVAL
Check Corporate Policy & Agency Spending Limits

AGENCY_APPROVAL_REQUIRED → MANUAL_APPROVAL_PENDING
Agency Policy Exception Review - Not a Payment Failure

PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT_READY
Issue Single-Use Corporate Virtual Card - VCC
Locked to Case, Option & Approved Fare

REBOOKING
Dispatch Rebooking Subprocess with VCC Credentials

AUTHORIZED REBOOKING
Airline NDC API / Playwright Partner Portal Engine

VERIFYING_BOOKING
Independently Verify PNR on Airline Host System

VERIFYING_TICKET
Confirm Electronic Ticket - e-Ticket Issuance

PAYMENT_AUTH_PENDING → PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED → PAYMENT_CAPTURED
Record Settlement with Card Issuer

DONE - RESCUED
Update Core Booking Record to 'Rescued'

FINAL WHATSAPP CONFIRMATION
Verified Itinerary + Confirmed PNR
e-Ticket Status (ISSUED & VALIDATED)
Itinerary Link + Baggage Transfer Guidance
(Boarding Pass Opens at Carrier Check-In 24h Prior)

Definitive Booking Failure
(e.g., Seat Sold / Inventory Locked)

Void Uncaptured VCC Authorization
or Refund Captured Payment

PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED → RECONCILING
Query Carrier Host using Idempotency Key (caseId)
